name: pix-mono
description: Monorepo of Pi Coding Agent extensions (pix-*)

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.base.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/pix-mcp/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/pix-mcp/tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.check: biome check packages scripts/check-versions.ts scripts/check-versions.test.ts scripts/deps.test.ts scripts/publish-all.ts scripts/static-analysis.ts scripts/static-analysis.test.ts scripts/package-smoke.ts
scripts.check:fix: biome check --write packages scripts/check-versions.ts scripts/check-versions.test.ts scripts/deps.test.ts scripts/publish-all.ts scripts/static-analysis.ts scripts/static-analysis.test.ts scripts/package-smoke.ts
